guardrails: Do not use harsh geometric shadows; stick to soft light diffusion.
Avoid high-contrast primary colors; use desaturated nebula tones.
Don't use thin, spidery fonts; keep the typography bold and grounded.
Avoid cluttered backgrounds; maintain a deep, dark atmospheric void.
design.layout: A high-impact immersive canvas with a floating pill-shaped navigation bar centered at the top. The left-aligned typography creates a weighted balance against the right-aligned human hand and central glowing orb.
design.motion: Slow, drifting ambient motion for the orb and cosmic dust layers. Subtle hover-triggered glass morphism shifts on the navigation bar and primary buttons using ease-in-out transitions.
design.centerpiece: A hyper-realistic 3D glass orb refracting cosmic light, suspended above a detailed human hand to symbolize personal agency and universal connection.

typography.body: Inter, sans-serif regular with generous tracking
typography.display: Inter, sans-serif bold with tight leading and optical kerning
typography.mono: IBM Plex Mono, or similar geometric sans for small utility labels/captions

design.mood: A cinematic, mystical, and aspirational 'dark mode' aesthetic that feels both futuristic and humanistic.
